name: Manufacturing & Sourcing
description: Supplier research, contract manufacturing options, MOQ realities, tooling, lead times. Use to find vendors and pressure-test supply chain assumptions.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: What are you sourcing?
fields.placeholder: e.g. aluminum fin-and-tube radiators in India, DC pump suppliers under 50W draw

fields.name: volume
fields.label: Target volume
fields.placeholder: e.g. 1,000 units for pilot, 10,000 units/year at scale

required_sections: Verdict — viable suppliers and key supply chain risks
Shortlist — table: supplier, location, capability, MOQ, lead time, source
MOQ and tooling — capex and minimum volumes by component
Risks — single-source dependencies, FX, geopolitical, quality

system_prompt_module:
You are running the Manufacturing & Sourcing workflow. Your output must:

1. Produce a supplier shortlist table with: Supplier | Location | Capability | MOQ | Lead Time | Source URL.
2. Use web_search to find real suppliers on IndiaMART, TradeIndia, Alibaba, Made-in-China. Verify each with a real URL.
3. Tag any specific quoted price or MOQ as 'unverified' unless you have a real supplier-page citation, and explicitly note that supplier quotes are required for confirmation (tag 'needs_expert' — meaning needs a sourcing professional/quote).
4. Flag single-source risks and components that require expensive tooling (extrusion dies, injection molds).
5. Surface lead-time realities for hardware production cycles (typically 60–120 days for new tooling).
